profile.headline: Software Developer III at GTN
profile.summary:
Hard working, intelligent, and adaptable software developer. A tech-savvy and creative problem solver with strong teamwork skills that enjoys challenging projects.

GitHub: https://github.com/x3igh7

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Molina Healthcare provides managed healthcare services under the Medicaid and Medicare programs, and through the state insurance marketplaces. Bright Health was sold to Molina in January 2023.

◾ Continued supporting the software and systems originally developed at Bright Health Care
◾ As development team members left, took on full responsibility of the file transfer processing backend
◾ Updated all backend code for Azure Durable Functions from .NET 6 to .NET 8
◾ Migrated Durable Functions form in-process model to isolated model
◾ Refactored backend code to include better logging to Application Insights, context tracing across functions, and process visibility in the database as well as the UI
◾ Improved ability of the system to process multiple files for a single task as well as the ability to schedule intervals between runs

Technical Skills Utilized: C#, .NET, React, React Testing Library, Typescript, Azure Functions, Durable Functions, Azure DevOps, SQL Server, Terraform, Application Insights, Github
positions.insights: Skills: React · .NET · Azure DevOps Services · Microsoft SQL Server · Serverless Functions

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Bright HealthCare provides health insurance on ACA marketplaces.

◾ In order to monitor and manage daily file transfer tasks, gathered requirements and designed UI from ground up by engaging with stakeholders
◾ Created UI mockups in Miro and user stories in JIRA
◾ Built UI using React and the Next.js framework
◾ Utilized the Emotion CSS library to manage styles
◾ Used ReactQuery to manage and cache data
◾ Implemented Authentication using MSAL and Microsoft SSO
◾ Built build pipelines in AzureDevops that triggered off of Github events
◾ Created REST APIs using .NET and Azure Function Apps and Dapper as the ORM
◾ Created tables, views, and stored procedures in SQL Server
◾ Wrote .NET unit tests with MSTest and React unit tests with RTF
◾ Maintained automated UI tests using Playwright
◾ Managed infrastructure code in Terraform
◾ Held regular check-ins with users and stakeholders to assess priorities and identify critical new features or application deficiencies 


Technical Skills Utilized: C#, .NET, MSTest, React, React Testing Library Typescript, AzureDevops, SQL Server, Terraform, Github, Playwright, Microsoft Authentication Library

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
GateKeeper Systems leads the industry in specialized ground transportation and airfield inspection systems for airports of all sizes.

Redesigned and revamped UI and relevant backend services as a part of a modernization effort for GateKeeper's airport inspections app.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
CPSI is a healthcare technology company that develops software for small and rural hospitals.

◾ Converted .NET Framework and AngularJS legacy apps to .NET core  and Angular
◾ Helped develop and design microservices infrastructure
◾ Designed and implemented event dispatching and handling via RabbitMQ across microservices 
◾ Architected, created user stories, and developed new data driven dashboard app for aggregating and reviewing patient data
◾ Helped lead design and development for next-gen unified web interface and microservices architecture to be implemented across all CPSI products
◾ Built UI library using Lit, Lerna repositories and Storybook

Technical Skills Utilized: C#, dotnetcore, Angular, LitElement, Typescript, Lerna, Storybook, RabbitMQ, Kafka, PostgreSQL, HTML5, SCSS

positions.title: Website Administrator
positions.description:
Elephant Rock Media is comprised of multiple business entities including the Forum on Education and Elephant Rock Books. Elephant Rock Books is an independent book publishing company based out of Ashford, CT. The Forum on Education produces multimedia tools that improve student outcomes and advance teacher development.

http://www.elephantrockbooks.com: Maintain pre-existing site. Currently employs mostly HTML and CSS, with a touch of jQuery.

https://www.forumoneducation.org/: Created from the ground up using Ruby on Rails, various open source javascript libraries, Stripe, and PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Outsell is a venture-backed technology company that offers a SaaS cross-channel marketing platform, Outsell Fuel, to automotive brands & their dealers.

◾ Joined as an hourly intern and was later hired on as a full time developer
◾ Developed various one-off projects such as an on-boarding app for new clients integrated with Salesforce and an ad-hoc internal reporting solution Full-stack agile development
◾ Assisted with developing new features and maintaining legacy PHP web application and services
◾ Assisted with development of new features on next-gen ASP .NET web application
◾ Lead AngularJS UI development on a ASP .NET backend for new web application for an independent venture
◾ Developed and designed services to handle monthly subscription payments using Stripe and integrated solution with company’s Quickbooks instance

Technical Skills Utilized: C#, .NET, ASP .NET, Moq, PHP, Ruby, Rails, Javascript, jQuery & jQuery UI, KnockoutJS, AngularJS, Typescript, Backbone, R, Shiny Server, SQLServer, MySQL, HTML5, SASS, LESS, APIs (Twilio, Quickbooks, Facebook, Stripe, SalesForce.com, AWS).

positions.title: Ruby on Rails Apprentice
positions.description:
Member of Launch Academy’s inaugural Boston class. Launch Academy is a 10-week, immersive  bootcamp taking eager learners with little to no experience and teaching them what it takes to add value as a junior contributor to a software engineering team. At culmination of the program, graduates are placed at one of the tech companies attending Career Day as junior web developers specialized in Ruby on Rails.

Specialties: Full-Stack, Ruby, Rails, HTML, CSS, Test Driven Development (Capybara and 
Rspec).

positions.title: Paid Marketing Intern
positions.description: Reported to VP of Product Marketing. Mastered Jaspersoft iReport and JasperReport Server. Developed interactive user reports in JasperSoft iReport using SQL and Java/Groovy.
